name: scholar-evaluation
description: ScholarEval - systematic scoring of research papers, literature reviews, theses and methodology quality, to assess or evaluate academic and scientific writing. Use when assessing research papers, evaluating literature reviews, scoring research methodologies, analyzing scientific writing quality, or applying structured evaluation criteria to academic work. Provides comprehensive assessment across multiple dimensions including problem formulation, literature review, methodology, data collection, analysis, results interpretation, and scholarly writing quality.
